def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    mask = objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs', 'weight_family': 'gap_linear'})
    gap = objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    raw_weight = gap.clamp_min(0.0)

    # Tie-zone filtering: suppress weights for very small gaps (<= tiezone_eps)
    tiezone_eps = float(extra.get('tiezone_eps', 0.1))
    tiezone_slope = float(extra.get('tiezone_slope', 10.0))
    tiezone_mask = raw_weight > tiezone_eps
    # Smooth ramp: linear from 0 at tiezone_eps to 1 at tiezone_eps + 1/slope
    ramp_width = 1.0 / tiezone_slope
    ramp_start = tiezone_eps
    ramp_end = tiezone_eps + ramp_width
    ramp_mask = (raw_weight > ramp_start) & (raw_weight < ramp_end)
    ramp_vals = (raw_weight - ramp_start) * tiezone_slope
    scaled_weight = torch.where(tiezone_mask, torch.where(ramp_mask, ramp_vals, torch.ones_like(raw_weight)), torch.zeros_like(raw_weight)) * raw_weight

    # Clamp weights to prevent extreme values
    clamp_lo = float(extra.get('clamp_lo', 0.25))
    clamp_hi = float(extra.get('clamp_hi', 4.0))
    weight = scaled_weight.clamp(clamp_lo, clamp_hi)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs', 'weight_family': 'gap_linear'})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    mask = objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs', 'weight_family': 'gap_bandpass_clamped'})

    gap = objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    gap_pos = gap.clamp(min=0.0)

    # Bandpass parameters - emphasize mid-range gaps
    low_thresh = float(extra.get('bandpass_low', 0.3))
    high_thresh = float(extra.get('bandpass_high', 2.5))
    tau = float(extra.get('weight_tau', 1.0))

    # Weight ramps linearly from 0 at low_thresh to 1 at midpoint
    midpoint = 0.5 * (low_thresh + high_thresh)
    # Ramp up factor (0 at low_thresh, 1 at midpoint)
    ramp_up = (gap_pos - low_thresh).clamp(min=0.0, max=midpoint - low_thresh) / max(midpoint - low_thresh, 1e-6)
    # Ramp down factor (1 at midpoint, 0 at high_thresh)
    ramp_down = (high_thresh - gap_pos).clamp(min=0.0, max=high_thresh - midpoint) / max(high_thresh - midpoint, 1e-6)

    weight_unclamped = tau * gap_pos * ramp_up * ramp_down

    clamp_lo = float(extra.get('clamp_lo', 0.1))
    clamp_hi = float(extra.get('clamp_hi', 3.0))
    weight = weight_unclamped.clamp(min=clamp_lo, max=clamp_hi)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs', 'weight_family': 'gap_bandpass_clamped'})

margin_scale = 1.3 * sigmoid(12 * (margin_scale_raw - 0.15))
scaled_margin = margin * margin_scale

def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    bias = float(extra.get('bias', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('bias', 0.5)))
    gamma = float(extra.get('gamma', 2.0))

    abs_delta_rank_mean = ops.mean(ops.abs(delta_rank)) + 1e-6
    delta_rank_mean = ops.mean(delta_rank)
    diff = ops.sub(delta_rank, delta_rank_mean)
    delta_rank_var = ops.mean(ops.mul(diff, diff)) + 1e-6
    delta_rank_std = ops.sqrt(delta_rank_var)

    cv = ops.div(delta_rank_std, abs_delta_rank_mean)
    beta = ops.mul(0.15, ops.sigmoid(ops.neg(ops.mul(15.0, ops.sub(cv, 0.2)))))

    sp_arg = ops.mul(0.5, delta_rank)
    bias_dynamic = ops.div(ops.mul(bias, ops.softplus(sp_arg)), ops.add(abs_delta_rank_mean, 0.2))
    scaled_bias = ops.tanh(ops.mul(gamma, bias_dynamic))

    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    margin_scale_raw = ops.div(delta_rank_std, ops.add(abs_delta_rank_mean, 0.1))
    margin_scale = ops.mul(1.3, ops.sigmoid(ops.mul(12.0, ops.sub(margin_scale_raw, 0.15))))
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(margin, margin_scale)

    weighted_margin = ops.sub(ops.mul(alpha, scaled_margin), ops.mul(beta, delta_rank))
    biased_margin = ops.add(weighted_margin, scaled_bias)

    x = ops.clamp(biased_margin, -14.0, 14.0)

    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)

    loss = ops.sum(weighted_loss)
    return loss

def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    bias = float(extra.get('bias', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('bias', 0.5)))
    gamma = float(extra.get('gamma', 2.0))

    abs_delta_rank_mean = ops.mean(ops.abs(delta_rank)) + 1e-6
    delta_rank_mean = ops.mean(delta_rank)
    diff = ops.sub(delta_rank, delta_rank_mean)
    delta_rank_var = ops.mean(ops.mul(diff, diff)) + 1e-6
    delta_rank_std = ops.sqrt(delta_rank_var)

    cv = ops.div(delta_rank_std, abs_delta_rank_mean)
    beta = ops.mul(0.15, ops.sigmoid(ops.neg(ops.mul(15.0, ops.sub(cv, 0.2)))))

    sp_arg = ops.mul(0.5, delta_rank)
    bias_dynamic = ops.div(ops.mul(bias, ops.softplus(sp_arg)), ops.add(abs_delta_rank_mean, 0.2))
    scaled_bias = ops.tanh(ops.mul(gamma, bias_dynamic))

    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    margin_scale_raw = ops.div(delta_rank_std, ops.add(abs_delta_rank_mean, 0.1))
    margin_scale = ops.mul(1.3, ops.sigmoid(ops.mul(12.0, ops.sub(margin_scale_raw, 0.15))))
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(margin, margin_scale)

    weighted_margin = ops.sub(ops.mul(alpha, scaled_margin), ops.mul(beta, delta_rank))
    biased_margin = ops.add(weighted_margin, scaled_bias)

    x = ops.clamp(biased_margin, -14.0, 14.0)

    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)

    loss = ops.sum(weighted_loss)
    return loss
